title: KOHLER Forte/Bancroft Slide Bar Trim Kit (K-349-BN, Vibrant Brushed Nickel)

comparisons.notes: Kohler K-349-BN Vibrant Brushed Nickel variant, same trim kit
Kohler K-349-BN Brushed Nickel, in stock

writeup: Kohler's K-349 trim kit dresses up the plain K-8524 or K-9069 handshower slide bar with metal discs and bar inserts that match the Forte and Bancroft collections. This is the Vibrant Brushed Nickel finish, which EasyPlumbing sells for $41.68 and Ferguson Home for $60.44. Woot had very few in stock when it posted.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon listing is KOHLER K-349-BN Forte/Bancroft Slide Bar Trim Kit, Vibrant Brushed Nickel; matches Woot's ASIN and finish
